audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[4].side and [5].side read Skill and phases[6].side read Yasuo, while content win[4], win[5], win[6] all read Zed and the packet levelChart agrees with the content layer on those three rows.
audit.why: Level 6 onward Zed's mark plus first-item burst is the kill pattern the whys already describe, and phases[6].why is written from Zed's side ("Late Zed picks"). Rows 0-3 are Skill in both layers and stay untouched.
audit.corrected: phases[4], [5], [6] side set to Zed; win[N] untouched because it already reads Zed on all three.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage gate was "when Windwall is down" with no cooldown attached, so the reader had no idea how long that window lasts.
audit.why: Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17 and lasts 4 seconds — a wasted wall at rank 1 is a 25-second lane. Steel Tempest is 4s and only knocks up at 2 stacks; Sweeping Blade is 0.5s but cannot re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds; Last Breath is 70/50/30.
audit.corrected: 25s and the 4-second duration written into the cooldowns field, dos bullets, spikes[0] and phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent: one Wind Wall covers a single line, but Zed and his shadow throw two shuriken lines, so splitting the angles is what beats it; and Last Breath requires an Airborne target, which normally has to come from his own 2-stack Steel Tempest.
audit.why: Riot text: Wind Wall "creates a moving wall that blocks all enemy projectiles"; Zed Q — "Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens", flagged projectile. Last Breath: "Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion"; Steel Tempest knocks Airborne only at 2 stacks.
audit.corrected: Angle-splitting written into tradeGood, phases[0]/[2]/[3].why, spikes[0] and mid; the airborne requirement into breakdown.carry and spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint), and dosFull[2].d offered a "fifteen-second invitation" that does not match any rank of Wind Wall.
audit.why: Wind Wall is 25s at rank 1 and 17s at rank 5 — never 15.
audit.corrected: Corrected to 25s at rank 1 in both fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string and dontsFull[2].d the tradeBad string, both under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles.

notes: Chart: full rows 4, 5 and 6 disagreed with content win[] (Zed on all three) and with the packet; sides moved to Zed, no win[N] edits needed. The decisive interaction the page never stated is that Zed and his shadow throw two shuriken lines while one Wind Wall covers one line — splitting the angles, not waiting out the wall, is the actual answer, and the wall is 25s at rank 1 (the page said fifteen). Also added that Last Breath requires an Airborne target that normally comes from his own 2-stack Steel Tempest. Left standing without verification: spikes[1].text and the late paragraph claim Death Mark's delayed damage is unblockable by Wind Wall. That is consistent with Riot's text (the wall blocks projectiles; the mark is delayed damage) but Riot does not state it, so the existing wording was left untouched rather than strengthened.
